To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
consumer satisfaction is a critical factor that influences consumers' repurchase intention in platform online retailing.
the quality of the product and price are important factors affecting the customer’s repurchase intention in the platform online retailing.

the consumer repurchase intention of platform online retail is significantly affected by the consumer satisfaction, the consumer satisfaction is positively affected by product quality, price and not affected by website design, order fulfillment and consumer service quality, and the consumer repurchase of platform online retail can be improved by improving the consumer satisfaction through the product quality and price.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impacts of E-service quality on customers’ repurchase intention in platform online retailing, which can provide some references for the development of platform online retailers in China.
the impacts of e-service quality on customers’ repurchase intention. It is a useful reference to online retailing in China and abroad.
how to win, satisfy, and retain consumers in the platform online retailing, and provides some useful implications to platform online retailing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the online retailers should pay attention to the product quality and price advantage of product, and enhance consumer satisfaction to increase the repurchase intention of consumers.
online retailers should focus on improving product quality and price advantage, and then pay attention to improving customer satisfaction.
platform online retailers should improve their service quality to win customers’ satisfaction, and enhance their product quality and price advantage to retain them.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this study is the first empirical study on the impact of E-service quality on customer repurchase intention in platform online retailing.
the study of the impact factors of customer repurchase is a necessary work for platform online retailers, which is also an effective way for them to improve the customer repurchase rate.
this paper provides the theoretical basis for the platform online retailers to enhance their customer repurchase intention.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quality of the product is the most important factor that influences customer’s repurchase intention.

the platform retailers should pay more attention to the quality of product and the price, and then to the quality of website design, information and consumer service, and finally the quality of order fulfillment.

platform online retailing can be a viable business model, and the key is to improve the quality of products, prices and services to enhance customer satisfaction, and then enhance the customer repurchase intention.
